meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把一个多步骤流程（叫 DAG）存成有名字的文件；之后你说这个名字，它会按保存的定义启动一次新运行，不必每次重新描述步骤。每次运行自动带时间戳，避免互相覆盖。
howto.when: 当你想保存一个多步骤流程、运行之前保存过的流程，或反复跑同一个流程时，Claude 就会使用这个技能。

say.text: 把当前这个流程保存下来，命名为 nightly-audit。
say.note: 定义存入本地库并立刻试跑一次。
会以新时间戳启动一次全新运行。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can save a multi-step workflow (a DAG) under a named file. When you later speak that name, it starts a fresh run from the saved definition instead of you restating all steps. Each run automatically gets a timestamp suffix, so runs stay distinct.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to save a DAG, run one you saved before, or repeatedly reuse the same multi-agent workflow.

say_en.note: Stores it locally and does a quick test run.
Starts a fresh run with a new timestamp.
